children: is recalling 98,828 vehicles in the U.S. over an obstructed rearview camera image that can reduce the driver’s view behind the vehicle,
reported, citing the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.
The recall affects certain R1S vehicles from model years 2022 through 2027, R1T vehicles from model years 2022 through 2026, and 2027 R2 vehicles, according to the report.
The automaker has released an over-the-air software update, free of charge, as part of the recall remedy.

title: Rivian recalls 98,828 U.S. vehicles over rearview camera visibility issue - report
